composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a kingfisher in deliberate coarse pixel art using copper orange, teal and warm cream. Perch it on one short geometric branch, turning its head with alert composure and keeping the beak compact. Use clearly visible square pixels without antialiasing or simulated screen effects. A plain muted blue field lets the strong bird silhouette remain readable, with no game interface. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
